intuition: A uniform square becomes one leaf; otherwise split it into four equal quadrants.

brute_force.approach: Inspect each region cell-by-cell before recursively creating its children.

optimal.approach: Build a prefix-sum table so each region's number of ones determines uniformity in constant time.
optimal.space: O(n^2) for prefix sums and output nodes

edge_cases: A uniform grid serializes as one leaf.
A mixed 2-by-2 grid creates four leaf children.
Internal-node values are ignored by the quad-tree definition.
